description.zh: 数据质量监控运行最早开始时间。
description.en: The earliest start time of a data quality scan run to include in the results. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 数据质量监控运行最晚开始时间。
description.en: The latest start time of a data quality scan run to include in the results. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
The ID of the data quality scan.

description.zh:
扩展的查询Filter，目前支持以下过滤参数：
- TaskInstanceId  调度任务实例ID
- RunNumber          实例运行次数
description.en:
An object with advanced filter conditions. The following parameters are supported:

- `TaskInstanceId`: The ID of the task instance.

- `RunNumber`: The run number of the instance.

description.zh: 列表翻页查询页码，默认为1。
description.en: The page number to return. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 列表翻页查询页大小，默认为10。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
排序字段列表，支持修改时间、创建时间等字段，格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（默认Asc，可以省略）。排序字段的枚举值如下：
- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)
- Id (Desc/Asc)
description.en:
The sort field and order for the results. The format is `FieldName Order`. The default order is ascending (Asc). Supported fields:

- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)

- Id (Desc/Asc)

description.zh:
数据质量校验结果状态。
- Pass
- Running
- Error
- Fail
- Warn
description.en:
The status of the data quality scan run. Valid values:

- Pass

- Running

- Error

- Fail

- Warn

title.zh: 数据质量扫描运行记录查询

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: This feature requires DataWorks basic edition or higher.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-data-quality-scan-runs --data-quality-scan-id 10001 --create-time-from 1710239005403 --create-time-to 1710239005403 --status Fail --sort-by CreateTime_Desc --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --project-id 12345 --filter TaskInstanceId=111 RunNumber=1 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListDataQualityScanRuns --region cn-hangzhou --Status Fail --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --Filter '{"TaskInstanceId":"111","RunNumber":"1"}' --SortBy CreateTime_Desc --CreateTimeFrom 1710239005403 --ProjectId 12345 --CreateTimeTo 1710239005403 --DataQualityScanId 10001
